paragraphs.text: Urzmaktok Grojsh is a second-year student at Witherbloom College within Strixhaven University. Known for his tireless work ethic and rigorous academic standards, Urzmaktok is often found buried in study or quietly refining experimental plant species in his spare time. He is a prominent member of the Fantastical Horticulture Club and works as a specimen preparer in the Campus Magic Labs.

Urzmaktok Grojsh is one of Witherbloom 's most diligent students. He is famously punctual—always the first to arrive and the last to leave the lecture hall — and regularly requests extra assignments from his instructors. Despite maintaining excellent grades, Urzmaktok never flaunts his success, and he tends to treat most coursework as elementary. Whispers among his peers suggest he may be quietly accumulating enough credits to graduate with multiple degrees.

Urzmaktok holds a job at the Campus Magic Labs, where he works as a specimen preparer. The position supports his studies and grants him valuable lab access for independent experiments, often involving the magical cultivation of plants. His green thumb and love of magical botany make him a natural fit for the Fantastical Horticulture Club, where he works to create new species of flora with potential alchemical or medicinal applications.
He is known for insisting that everyone address him by his full first name. Any attempt to shorten "Urzmaktok" into a nickname is met with silence or disregard.

Urzmaktok's dedication to scholarship positively influences those connected to him. Friends and acquaintances often find classmates eager to study alongside them, either out of respect for Urzmaktok's reputation or through his direct encouragement.

Conversely, those Urzmaktok deems unworthy or uninteresting tend to experience social isolation within academic circles. When they attempt to form study groups, most students politely decline, convinced these individuals are unlikely to succeed.
The D&D Strixhaven: A Curriculum of Chaos guide erroneously list his species as "orc".
